name: TGPSC Group 2
pattern: 4 papers × 150 questions × 150 marks, 2½ hours each (600 marks) + interview 75 as per the 2022 scheme. Check the new notification for changes.

papers.name: Paper I: General Studies & General Abilities

sections.name: General Studies & Abilities
topics: Current affairs: regional, national and international
International relations and events
General science; India's achievements in science and technology
Environmental issues; disaster management: prevention and mitigation
World geography, Indian geography and geography of Telangana
History and cultural heritage of India
Society, culture, heritage, arts and literature of Telangana
Policies of Telangana State
Social exclusion; rights issues (gender, caste, tribe, disability) and inclusive policies
Logical reasoning, analytical ability and data interpretation
Basic English (10th class standard)

sections.name: Socio-cultural history of India and Telangana
topics: Indus Valley civilisation; Vedic age
Buddhism and Jainism
Mauryas, Guptas and South Indian dynasties
Delhi Sultanate, Mughals, Bhakti and Sufi movements
British rule, socio-religious reform movements, national movement
Satavahanas, Ikshvakus, Vishnukundins in Telangana
Kakatiyas and Qutb Shahis
Asaf Jahis and Hyderabad State; social and cultural movements in Telangana

sections.name: Overview of the Indian Constitution and politics
topics: Making of the Constitution, Preamble, salient features
Fundamental rights, directive principles, fundamental duties
Union and State executive and legislature
Centre–State relations; federalism
Local government: 73rd and 74th amendments
Judiciary and judicial review
Election Commission and other constitutional bodies
Welfare and protection mechanisms for SC, ST, BC, minorities and women

sections.name: Social structure, issues and public policies
topics: Indian social structure: caste, family, tribe, religion
Social issues: inequality, gender, child labour, regionalism
Social movements
Telangana-specific social issues
Welfare policies and programmes of India and Telangana

sections.name: Indian economy: issues and challenges
topics: Growth and development; national income
Demography, poverty and unemployment
Planning and NITI Aayog
Agriculture, industry and services
Money, banking, inflation and fiscal policy

sections.name: Economy and development of Telangana
topics: Economy of Hyderabad State and Telangana (to 2014)
Land reforms and agriculture in Telangana
Irrigation and allied sectors
Industry and services in Telangana
Telangana budget and welfare schemes

sections.name: Issues of development and change
topics: Development dynamics and regional inequality
Economic reforms since 1991
Sustainable development and environment
Displacement and rehabilitation
Social and economic change

papers.name: Paper IV: Telangana Movement & State Formation

sections.name: The idea of Telangana (1948–1970)
topics: Hyderabad State in independent India; Mulki rules
States Reorganisation and the 1956 Gentlemen's Agreement
Safeguards and their violation
1969 Telangana agitation

sections.name: Mobilisational phase (1971–1990)
topics: Six Point Formula and Article 371D
G.O. 610 and employment issues
Cultural and political mobilisation in the 1970s–80s

sections.name: Towards formation of Telangana State (1991–2014)
topics: Rise of the movement in the 1990s; civil society and students
Formation of TRS (2001) and political process
Srikrishna Committee; Million March, Sakala Janula Samme
AP Reorganisation Act and Telangana State formation (2 June 2014)
